terminal_name: Ajaokuta mini-LNG cluster (5 plants: Prime LNG, NGML/Gasnexus LNG, BUA LNG, Highland LNG, LNG Arete)
issue: Five distinct small-scale (modular) domestic LNG liquefaction plants broke ground together at Ajaokuta, Kogi State on 2025-01-30/02-03 (NNPC + partners; combined ~97.5 mmscfd, ~$500m) and none are in GEM. This is a >5-candidate-cluster in one country (CLAUDE.md / Discovery SOP §12 systematic-gap trigger) AND raises a genuine methodology-scope question: does GEM track sub-MTPA modular domestic mini-LNG liquefaction plants, and if so as one terminal-per-plant or one Ajaokuta cluster terminal with five units? Staged to monitor_list rather than mass-generating new_terminal records.
